en: Looker
Every leader in one fort, each sure their old machine is here. I have never seen so many angry people in one place!
What a performance. I may buy a ticket for next season myself. In disguise, naturally.
Shall we sail back to the harbour?
{player} sailed back with Looker...
Mars
You again! Our boss says his old machine is in this fort, and nobody's getting near it before he does.
Ugh, fine! Go and argue with him yourself. He's in a mood.
Jupiter
A rumour dragged us across the sea, and now a Champion blocks the corridor. What a day.
Hmph. Go on, then. Don't expect him to thank you.
Archer
Team Rocket goes where its boss goes, and the boss heard his old machine was here. Step aside, child.
Unbelievable. Very well. The boss can deal with you.
Ariana
We sailed all night on a rumour. I am in no mood for children.
...Go. Before I change my mind.
Tabitha
Hoo hah! Team Magma and Team Aqua in one room, and both bosses sure the same fort hides their machine!
Hoo... You're as tough as ever. Go on, then, before they start shouting again.
Shelly
Ahahaha! If the boss's machine is here, Team Aqua takes it home. You won't stop us this time!
Fine, fine! Go and see the bosses. Mind your ears.
Zinzolin
A letter told Lord Ghetsis his great machine had been raised from the sea. And here you are. How tiresome.
Cold, cold, cold... Go, then. He is expecting nobody, least of all you.
Xerosic
I came to see this machine with my own eyes. Science demands it! And I find a Champion instead.
Fascinating. Still undefeatable. Go on, the boss is just behind me.
Celosia
The boss believes his weapon is here. I believe it would be rude to let you interrupt him.
How unfashionable, to lose. Go, then.
Cyrus
I was told the machine I built at the mountain's top had been rebuilt in this fort. I came to see if it was true.
There is no machine. Only you. Then let us finish what was left unfinished.
...Again. A world without spirit would never have lost to you. Perhaps that is the answer I came for.
Someone lured us all here. Whoever it is, they wanted an audience.
I find I have nowhere else to stand. Battle me, if you wish. Once a day is enough for either of us.
Tomorrow, then.
Come back tomorrow.
Giovanni
A note said my old machine had surfaced here, the one that made my Pokémon stronger than any other's. A lie, it seems.
But you are no lie. Come, then. Show me how far you have climbed.
Ha... I was a fool to come. And a fool to fight you. Twice the fool, then.
Find whoever wrote that note. I'd like a word with them myself.
I stay for the battles, nothing more. One today. Make it worth my while.
Hmph. Tomorrow.
That was today's. Come back tomorrow.
Maxie
My machine to widen the land, rebuilt here? I had to see it. And of course Archie had to see his.
There is no machine. There is only you, again. Fufufu... Very well.
I misjudged everything once more. At least I misjudged it in good company.
Archie and I have agreed on one thing today: we were both fooled.
A battle a day keeps my mind off the land. Shall we?
Tomorrow, then.
Once a day. Come back tomorrow.
Archie
Bwahaha! Somebody told me my machine to fill the seas was sitting in this fort. And here's Maxie, told the same about his!
No machine, eh? Then let's have a battle. I didn't sail all this way for nothing!
Bwah! Still the strongest thing in the room. I'll take that over any machine.
When I find whoever wrote that letter, I'm taking them sailing. A long way out.
A battle a day, Champion! The sea can wait.
Bwahaha! Same time tomorrow!
That's today's. Come back tomorrow!
Ghetsis
A letter swore my great machine had been raised from the sea floor. I came to claim what is mine.
And I find you. Every time, it is you! Then I will crush you here, where nobody will see.
Impossible... Impossible! Whoever lured me here will regret it.
Leave me. I am composing a very long complaint.
You return to mock me daily, it seems. Then battle me, and be gone.
Tomorrow, I will win.
Once a day is more than enough of you.
Lysandre
I was told my ultimate weapon had been raised and brought to this fort. A beautiful lie, and I believed it.
Since you are here instead, let us see whether the world you chose was worth choosing.
...It was. I suppose that is the answer I came for.
Someone wanted us all in one room. I would admire the staging, if I weren't the one staged.
A battle a day. A small, beautiful thing. Shall we?
Tomorrow, then.
That was today's. Come back tomorrow.
Ismene
Bravo! Bravo! Every act played, every villain beaten, and in front of a full house. Well, a full fort.
Yes, it was me. I keep the Laurel Gallery's records. I've read every plan those leaders ever made, and every way you foiled them.
So I wrote each of them a little note: your old machine has come back. And here they all came, cross as cats!
I only wanted to see the whole story on one stage. And now, the finale. Mine!
Oh, wonderful! What an ending! Places, everyone, places!
The keep's old curtains swept shut across the stage bay...
...and opened on every leader in a row. Somewhat against their will, they bowed.
Ismene curtsied, and a little sign appeared at the door: TICKETS FOR NEXT SEASON, PLEASE ENQUIRE WITHIN.
Thank you, thank you! The leaders have agreed to stay on. Well, they didn't disagree. They'll battle anyone, once a day.
And you, Champion, have earned a title of your own. Do come back next season!
Not yet, not yet! The show isn't over until every act has played. Go and see the leaders in their bays.
